message: Apply Meena's decision on 3.6 of the adopted run (record/construction/build-and-test.md, decision 1): a pending row whose receivedAt is after the as-of date must never make the call fail. Rows are never refused; only the caller's asOf is checked (after today = 400, as now). A row received after the as-of date gets age 0, not over the limit. Drop the whole-list 400 for an asOf before a row's receivedAt (assumption A3); keep the 400 for a malformed asOf and for an asOf after today. Add tests: a row received tomorrow with no asOf returns 200 with age 0, and the 7/4/1 example as of 2026-10-13 still holds. Work in priorauth-api on its current branch request-age/pending-list-age; commit there, do not push. Tests only through ./scripts/verify.sh from the workspace root.
